description: Presidential Secretariat - Enlarge the period of time ending 15th June, 2024, up to 30th June, 2024 for rendering of the final report on completion of the tasks
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of a deadline for a Commission of Inquiry to submit its final report, which is a legal/regulatory matter under the Commission of Inquiry Act. It involves the exercise of statutory powers (Section 4 of Act No. 17 of 1948) and modifies a legal timeline, falling squarely within Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal amendments and regulatory procedures. While it names the President, it does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments (Types 1-3), but rather the administration of a legal commission.
